zh: 现在没有进行中的会话

key: Allow TabFlick to control {0} in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
zh: 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 自动化里允许 TabFlick 控制「{0}」。
最近使用的浏览器标签和应用

key: Type a math expression in the search panel. The result shows on top; ↵ copies it.
zh: 在搜索面板里打一道算式，最上面一行出结果，回车拷贝。

key: Start or end an Amphetamine session, and lock the screen.
zh: Amphetamine 开始、结束会话，锁定屏幕。

key: Center, maximize, left or right half, next display and more, for the window you were using before opening the search panel.
zh: 居中、最大化、左右半屏、移到下一个显示器等，动的是打开搜索面板前在用的那个窗口。

key: Find a process by name or port and kill it after confirming.
zh: 按名字或端口找进程，确认后结束。

key: It may be waiting for you to save a document.

zh: 再结束一次时选「强制结束」。

key:
Accessibility permission is required.

Open: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility
Enable TabFlick (or the terminal app running it), then start again.
zh:
需要「辅助功能」权限。

前往：系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能，
打开 TabFlick（或运行它的终端应用），然后重新启动。

key:
CGEvent.tapCreate failed.

Besides Accessibility, macOS sometimes also requires:
  System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring
After changing either, fully quit and reopen the app —
macOS only reads these permissions at process launch.
zh:
CGEvent.tapCreate 失败。

除了「辅助功能」，macOS 有时还要求：
  系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 输入监控
改完任一项后必须完全退出应用再打开 —— 权限只在进程启动时读取。

key: Open chrome://extensions in the address bar
Turn on Developer mode at the top right of the extensions page
zh: 打开扩展页右上角的「开发者模式」

key: Once Developer mode is on, drag the folder below onto the extensions page
zh: 开发者模式打开后，把下面的文件夹拖到扩展页上

key: Or click Load unpacked on the extensions page, press ⌘⇧G in the file dialog and paste the path
zh: 也可以点扩展页上的「加载已解压的扩展程序」，在选择框里按 ⌘⇧G 粘贴路径
已在 {0} 打开 {1} 个项目

key: Click ↻ on TabFlick Bridge in the extensions page
zh: 在扩展页的 TabFlick Bridge 上点 ↻

key: Files are already v{0}. Later updates won't need this.
zh: 文件已经换成 v{0}，以后的更新不用再点
读不到访达里选中的项目

key: Allow TabFlick to control Finder in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
zh: 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 自动化里允许 TabFlick 控制「访达」。

key: The extension is too old for this
zh: 扩展版本太旧，做不了这个操作

key: Download the latest extension zip, replace the folder, then reload it in chrome://extensions.
zh: 下载最新的扩展包替换原文件夹，再到 chrome://extensions 重新加载。

key: Couldn't load the notes for this version — they're on GitHub.
zh: 更新说明取不到，可以去 GitHub 看。

key: Needs approval in System Settings → General → Login Items
zh: 需要在「系统设置 → 通用 → 登录项」中批准

key: Prompts you when there's a new version, then installs and restarts.
zh: 有新版本时提示你，确认后自动装好重启。

key: The global switcher shortcut is left alone while these apps are frontmost. In-browser keys and the search panel are unaffected.
zh: 这些 App 在前台时不接管全局切换器的快捷键。浏览器里的键和搜索面板不受影响。
这个 App 认不出来

key: Its identifier couldn't be read. Try another one.
zh: 读不到它的标识符，换一个试试。
唤出切换器（按住修饰键循环）

key: Limit switching to the current window
zh: 只切换当前窗口的标签

key: Off means all windows share one list. Each window keeps its own order either way.
zh: 关掉则合并所有窗口的标签。每个窗口的使用顺序都是独立记的。

key: Strip is one row; grid wraps to fill the screen. In grid mode, ⌃ plus arrows moves in all four directions.
zh: 长条排成一行，宫格换行铺满一屏。宫格下 ⌃ + 方向键可以四向移动。
在浏览器之外也能唤出

key: Lists tabs from every browser, grouped by browser. It reuses the switcher shortcut and only opens outside a browser — give it its own key to use it anywhere.
zh: 列出所有浏览器的标签，按浏览器分组。默认沿用切换器快捷键，只在浏览器之外唤出；想在浏览器里也能用，单独给它设一个键。
没有发现已安装的 Chromium 系浏览器。

key: Install the extension once per browser. If a running browser shows Not connected, check whether the extension is turned off in its extensions page.
zh: 扩展要每个浏览器装一次。浏览器开着却显示未连接的，到它的扩展页看看扩展是不是关了。
已连接 · 扩展 v{0} 需要更新

key: Nothing pinned yet. Pin any tab in your browser.
zh: 还没有置顶。在浏览器里置顶任意标签。

key: Syncs both ways: pinning adds; unpinning or closing the tab removes, closing the whole window doesn't. Restored on restart, at the page you last viewed.
zh: 和浏览器双向同步：置顶即收藏，取消置顶或关掉标签即移除，关整个窗口不算。重启浏览器会自动恢复，停在你最后看的那一页。

key: Show close button on hover in the switcher
zh: 切换器中悬停显示关闭按钮

key: Hidden when only two tabs are left. Not available in the global switcher.
zh: 只剩两个标签时不显示。全局切换器没有这个按钮。

key: ⌘Z reopens the tab you just closed
Outside text fields, ⌘Z brings back the last closed tab or window; keep pressing to go further back. Tabs closed by auto-clean are skipped. Doesn't work on the New Tab page or chrome:// pages.
zh: 不在输入框里时，⌘Z 恢复最近关掉的标签或窗口，连按继续往前。自动清理关掉的不算。新标签页和 chrome:// 页面上不起作用。
自动清理未使用的标签

key: Closes tabs you haven't used in that long. Pinned, audible, grouped, and current tabs stay.
zh: 超时没用过的标签会被关掉。置顶、正在放声音、在标签组里、以及各窗口当前那个都不动。
置顶 / 取消置顶当前标签

key: The menu lists the {0} most recently opened; the rest live under More.
zh: 状态栏菜单按最近打开排序，平铺前 {0} 个，其余收在「更多」里。

key: The menu bar menu leaves out favorite folders and “Add Folder…”. They're still in the search panel.
zh: 状态栏菜单里不显示收藏的文件夹，也没有「添加文件夹…」。搜索面板里照样能搜到。

key: Nothing yet. Use “Add Folder…” in the menu bar, or open a folder in Finder and use “Add Current Finder Folder”.
zh: 还没有收藏。从状态栏菜单点「添加文件夹…」，或在 Finder 打开目录后点「收藏当前 Finder 目录」。

key: Removing an app takes it out of the Open With menu; use “Add App…” to bring any back — or to add editors and terminals the system misses.
zh: 移除即从「打开方式」菜单消失，随时用「添加 App…」加回；系统没枚举到的终端 / 编辑器也从这里补。

key: Type a title, URL or pinyin to find tabs, bookmarks, history, folders and apps. Tab changes scope, ⌘↩ shows actions for the selected item, and ⌘1–{0} picks a row.
zh: 输标题、网址或拼音，找浏览器标签、书签、历史记录、文件夹和应用。Tab 换范围，⌘↩ 展开对这一项的操作，按住 ⌘ 时用 1–{0} 直接选。
别的 App 里（搜所有浏览器）

key: Checked ones are in the cycle. The panel opens on the first; Tab moves down, ⇧Tab back up. Folders are your menu bar favorites — Enter opens with the last-used app, ⌘↩ picks another. Apps is off by default; Raycast users won't need it. Opened with the “In any other app” key, Apps comes before Browser tabs.
zh: 勾上的进循环。面板打开时是第一个，按 Tab 依次往下切，⇧Tab 往回。「文件夹」是状态栏收藏的那些，回车用上次的方式打开，⌘↩ 换一个；「应用」默认关，装了 Raycast 的用不上。用「别的 App 里」那个键打开时，「应用」排在「浏览器标签」前面。

key: The “Search X” rows shown under Search mode after the search engine. %s in the URL is replaced with the query.
zh: 「搜索」模式里列在搜索引擎后面的「在 X 搜索」。网址里的 %s 换成关键词。

key: Search the same thing again and what you picked last time comes first; Suggestions on the home list are what you pick often; Recent is ordered by the apps you switch to. All stored only on this Mac and cleared together.
zh: 同样的输入再搜时，上次选的那条排在前面；首页的「推荐」是你常选的；「最近使用」按你切换 App 的记录排。都只存在这台 Mac 上，清除时一起清掉。

key: Updated with TabFlick. They can't be removed, only turned off. A plugin that's off no longer shows up in the search panel or the menu bar.
zh: 跟着 TabFlick 一起更新，不能卸载，只能关掉。关掉的插件不再出现在搜索面板和菜单栏里。

key: No plugins installed yet. Pick one under Available.
zh: 还没有装插件，在下面「可安装」里挑。

key: Every plugin in the store is installed.
zh: 商店里的插件都装上了。

key: Official plugins only. Each one lists the sites it connects to, and anything else is blocked.
zh: 只有官方插件。装之前写明它会访问哪些网站，插件联网出了这个范围一律拦下。

key: If you keep its data (watchlists, saved cities), it comes back when you reinstall.
zh: 插件存的数据（比如自选、收藏的城市）保留的话，重装回来还在。

key: Turned off. Turn it on in Plugins for these settings to take effect.
zh: 已关闭。在「插件」页打开后这里的设置才生效。

key: Adds “{0}” to the menu bar menu; hover it to see the contents.
zh: 状态栏菜单里多一行「{0}」，展开看内容。

key: Type a keyword and that command comes first; ↩ runs it. Separate keywords with spaces. Leave it empty to search by the command's name.
zh: 打出关键词，这条命令排在最前，回车就执行。多个关键词用空格分开，不填就按命令名搜。

key: MRU tab switching, plus tab management and pins that persist.
zh: 按最近使用顺序切换标签，外加标签管理和置顶常驻。

key: Use at least one of ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥; ⇧ is reserved for reverse. Esc cancels. Works only while a browser is frontmost — watch out for the ⌃⇥ in terminals and editors.
zh: 至少带一个 ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥，⇧ 留给反向切换。Esc 取消录制。只在浏览器前台生效，别撞上终端和编辑器的 ⌃⇥。

key: Use at least one of ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥. Esc cancels. Works only while a browser is frontmost — watch out for ⌘T and ⌘D.
zh: 至少带一个 ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥。Esc 取消录制。只在浏览器前台生效，别撞上 ⌘T、⌘D。

key: Use at least one of ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥. Esc cancels. The in-browser key overrides the page's own; the other one works in every app.
zh: 至少带一个 ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥。Esc 取消录制。浏览器里那个会盖住网页自己的同名快捷键；别的 App 里那个在所有 App 里都生效。
未授权 —— 需要「辅助功能」权限
收藏当前 Finder 目录

key: Choose a folder to add to favorites
Browser's default search engine, in a new tab
zh: 浏览器默认搜索引擎，新标签打开

key: Filter by name, port or PID
zh: 按名称、端口或 PID 过滤

key: Couldn't load. Try again in a moment.
zh: 取不到数据，过一会儿再试。
没有匹配的浏览器标签
没有匹配的浏览器书签
没有匹配的已关闭标签

key: No favorite folders yet. Add one from the menu bar.
zh: 还没有收藏文件夹。状态栏菜单里可以添加。

key: {0} more tab(s) with this page are open; ⌘↩ closes them
zh: 还开着 {0} 个同样的页面，⌘↩ 可以一起关掉

key: Use Force Kill in the ⌘↩ actions.
Could not parse the release info
The update image could not be opened
The update image is missing the app
You have {0}. Download and install — it restarts on its own.
zh: 当前版本 {0}。点「下载并安装」，装完自动重启。

key: You have {0}. This release has no package for this Mac — grab one from the releases page.
zh: 当前版本 {0}。这一版没有适合这台 Mac 的安装包，去发布页手动下载。

key: You can download it manually from the releases page.
zh: 可以去发布页手动下载。

key: This window can't go full screen
“{0}” is already a favorite — moved to front

To favorite the current Finder folder, TabFlick asks Finder which folder its front window shows.

Allow TabFlick to control Finder under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
zh:
收藏当前 Finder 目录需要询问 Finder 前面的窗口在看哪个文件夹。

请在 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 自动化 中允许 TabFlick 控制「访达」。
没有可收藏的 Finder 窗口

key: Open the folder in Finder first, then use this item.
zh: 先在 Finder 里打开想收藏的文件夹，再点这一项。

key:
Extension v{0} is installed, but this app version needs extension v{1} or newer (the protocol changed; older extensions lose features).

Download the new extension package, replace your folder, then reload it in chrome://extensions.
zh:
当前扩展 v{0}，本版应用需要 v{1} 或更新的扩展（协议有变化，旧扩展部分功能会失效）。

请下载新的扩展包替换原文件夹后，在 chrome://extensions 重新加载。

key: Port {0} is already in use. Another copy of TabFlick may already be running — check the menu bar.
zh: 端口 {0} 已被占用。可能已经有一个 TabFlick 在运行了 —— 看看菜单栏。
TabFlick 已停止拦截快捷键

key:
The keyboard hook was repeatedly disabled by the system, so TabFlick turned it off rather than risk interfering with your typing. ⌃⇥ now falls back to Chrome's built-in switching.

Restarting TabFlick restores it. If this keeps happening, please report it on GitHub.
zh:
键盘钩子被系统反复禁用，为避免影响你正常打字，TabFlick 已主动停用它。
⌃⇥ 现在回落到 Chrome 自带的切换方式。

重启 TabFlick 可以恢复。反复出现的话去 GitHub 反馈。
辅助功能权限已被移除

key:
TabFlick disabled its keyboard hook immediately, so your typing is unaffected. ⌃⇥ falls back to Chrome's built-in switching.

After granting the permission again, quit and reopen TabFlick — macOS only reads this permission when a process starts.
zh:
TabFlick 已经停用键盘钩子，不影响你正常打字。⌃⇥ 回落到 Chrome 自带的切换方式。

重新授予权限后，需要退出并重新打开 TabFlick 才会生效 —— macOS 只在进程启动时读取这项权限。

key: TabFlick could not install its keyboard hook
zh: TabFlick 无法安装键盘钩子
